items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Curbelo wrote the number and then I give it to Tito to make me an arrangement.

ctx.x: .. Nilo, Nilo Curbelo. In those days, as always, it's kind of difficult to write a Cuban music. The phrasing es very difficult, but Curbelo being Cuban and trumpet player so he had a more better idea to write the number than Tito Puente. Tito Puente was young, he haven't got that experience to write a real Cuban number, so Curbelo wrote the number and then I give it to Tito to make me an arrangement.
